definitions.explanation: The act of being forced to leave a building or land, typically by legal or official order.

examples.japanese: {立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じられた→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}している→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The residents are opposing the eviction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Due to redevelopment, the residents of this building are being asked to vacate by next month.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{立|た}ち{退|の}く→立ち退く：09011_tachinoku⟧ (to vacate, to move out). Used in legal and real estate contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じる→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧: to order an eviction
- {立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to demand eviction
- {立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: eviction compensation money
- {立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: eviction demand
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧{立|た}ち{退|の}き: forced eviction

USAGE:
Often appears in news about urban redevelopment, landlord-tenant disputes, and disaster evacuations. In Japan, tenants have strong legal protections, so {立|た}ち{退|の}き often involves negotiation over {立|た}ち{退|の}き⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (compensation).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{退去|たいきょ}→退去：06693_taikyo⟧: departure, vacating (more formal/neutral)
- ⟦{追|お}い{出|だ}す→追い出す：04625_oidasu⟧: to drive out, to kick out (more forceful)
